A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EEG-language modeling study. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original retrieval, linear-probe, and zero-shot classification experiments in Figure 2 and Tables 2–3, together with original appendix analyses.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and appendix analyses and reports revised zero-shot classification outcomes in Table 3.

M1.justification: The stated ELM_e,l loss changes: Equations 6–7 remove the exclusion indicator from each denominator, including the matched pair in normalization. The architecture and alignment procedure otherwise remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether the implementation changed.

E1.justification: Both versions use TUEG for pretraining, TUAB for normal/abnormal classification, and TUH EEG Epilepsy Corpus data to supplement retrieval evaluation (Appendix B). Dataset, task, and test-scenario coverage is retained.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains BYOL, VICReg, ContraWR, RP, TS, and CPC. The language-encoder and paired/shuffled-report comparisons also retain their participants. Figure 3's legend correction does not introduce or remove a comparator.

E3.justification: Appendix A.1 changes learning-rate scaling from 0.2 × BatchSize/256 to BaseLR × BatchSize/256, retaining stated base rates of 0.3 and 0.01. This corrects a previously stated setting; it does not establish reruns. Splits, preprocessing, budgets, metrics, and prompts otherwise remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 3 revises evidence about which report content supports zero-shot classification: ELM_l using interpretation text changes from above-chance to chance-level balanced accuracy. The report-shuffling, crop-length, temperature, prompt-sensitivity, overlap, and embedding analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Repeated-run and uncertainty-reporting practices are retained, including five-run standard deviations in the main results and three-seed error bars in Figure 6. Changed standard-deviation values in Table 3 are result revisions, not changes in statistical practice.

E6.justification: Table 3 revises results across all twelve configurations. ELM_l with LLM summaries changes from 84.32% to 71.98% balanced accuracy; its interpretation variant changes from 66.91% to 50.00%. The leading balanced-accuracy configuration shifts to ELM_e,l with all clusters at 83.16%. Retrieval, linear-probe, and appendix results remain unchanged. The cause of these substantial zero-shot revisions is undocumented.

T1.justification: Equations 6–7 change the formal contrastive-loss definitions by replacing sums excluding m=j with sums over all batch members. This is a mathematical correction rather than equivalent notation. No theorems, proofs, or formal assumptions are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and Discussion retain the same contributions: EEG-language pretraining, richer representations from diverse report content with contrastive learning, and improved label efficiency and zero-shot pathology detection.

C2.justification: Section 3.2.5 qualifies ELM_l trained on LLM summaries as the only consistently 'above-chance' zero-shot classifier, replacing 'high-performing.' This narrows its performance characterization in line with revised Table 3. Mechanism explanations and stated limitations otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix A.1 makes the learning-rate scaling instructions consistent with the stated model-specific base rates, improving reproducibility information. Architecture details, hardware, software, training times, preprocessing instructions, prompts, and data-access information are retained.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and all 52 references are unchanged. No cited work or novelty relationship is added or removed.

P1.justification: Section 3.2.1 removes a duplicated text-segmentation description. The author block is consolidated, and Appendix A.5 removes the erroneous word 'three' before its unchanged method list. These are localized edits; the narrative and section order remain stable.

P2.justification: Figure 3D replaces two identical 'CLIP' legend entries with 'Shuffled' and 'Paired,' retaining the plotted curves. Table 1 moves from page 6 to page 5, and the author layout and subsequent page flow change modestly. The figure and table inventory is retained.

improvement.justification: V2 improves clarity and reproducibility through the loss-normalization correction, consistent learning-rate instructions, corrected Figure 3 legend, and removal of duplicated prose. Its more cautious ELM_l interpretation better matches Table 3. These are limited, concrete gains; the unexplained numerical revisions do not establish improved empirical validity.
